ai_summary: Aavas Financiers Limited has been directed by the National Housing Bank (NHB) to pay INR 1.09 Crores in penal charges and immediately repay a INR 12.24 Crores refinance facility, citing issues with certain loan pools. This represents an unexpected liquidity demand totaling INR 13.33 Crores, signaling potential compliance or operational deficiencies related to the company's refinance activities. The company has committed to complying with the NHB's directions.
